description.value: Arcana Spirit Lounge is an occult-themed cocktail bar and restaurant hidden behind a 'Pet Psychic' storefront in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood. Created by Jason Kapalka, co-founder of PopCap Games, the interior features Ouija board tables, antique chandeliers, and Vancouver's only Zoltar machine alongside European fusion cuisine and hand-crafted cocktails. It is part of the same hospitality family as Storm Crow Alehouse in Vancouver and Storm Crow Manor in Toronto.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for arcanabar.com is fully accessible and confirms a real, active business at 238 Abbott St, Gastown. The OSM name 'Arcana Food and Spirits' differs from the website's consistent branding as 'Arcana Spirit Lounge' — this is flagged as a concern and the website value is used per rule 12. The FAQ explicitly confirms vegetarian, vegan, and GF menu options. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, takeout, or Wi-Fi information is mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name 'Arcana Food and Spirits' does not match the business's own branding 'Arcana Spirit Lounge' as used consistently throughout the website. OSM record may need a name correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant and cocktail bar in Gastown with a live website, current menu, and reservation system. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food and drinks in downtown Vancouver.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states: 'Our menu includes vegetarian (VEG), vegan (V), and gluten-free (GF) options, which are clearly marked.'
